srun_path.description: Absolute path to the SLURM `srun` executable used to launch jobs.

sbatch_path.description: Absolute path to the SLURM `sbatch` executable used to submit batch jobs.

scancel_path.description: Absolute path to the SLURM `scancel` executable used to cancel jobs.

squeue_path.description: Absolute path to the SLURM `squeue` executable used to query job status.

sinfo_path.description: Absolute path to the SLURM `sinfo` executable used to query cluster state.

enable_job_arrays.description: Whether to enable submission of SLURM job arrays. Recommended for compatibility with HPC workflows.

max_jobs_per_user.description: Maximum number of concurrent jobs allowed per user. Set to 0 for no limit.

default_timeout.description: Default timeout (in seconds) for job operations (e.g., stage-in/out, startup).

max_runtime.description: Maximum allowed job runtime in seconds. Set to 0 for no enforced limit (SLURM partition limits still apply).

environment_setup_script.description: Optional path to a shell script that sets up environment variables (e.g., module loading) before job execution.

slurm_defaults.description: Default SLURM request options applied to all jobs unless overridden.

partition.description: Default partition (queue) to submit jobs to.

extra_sbatch_options.description: Additional command-line options to pass to `sbatch` (e.g., '--exclusive', '--mail-type=end').

allowed_partitions.description: List of SLURM partition names users are allowed to submit to. Empty list = all partitions allowed (unless denied).

denied_partitions.description: List of SLURM partition names explicitly denied to users. Takes precedence over allowed_partitions.

enable_syslog.description: Whether to send job manager logs to the system syslog.

log_level.description: Verbosity level of job manager logging.

log_file.description: Path to the primary log file for the SLURM job manager.
